settings.title: Settings
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.public_address_tooltip: The address participants use to reach this server. It is announced to WebRTC clients, not bound locally, so a public address is correct even when this node is behind NAT.
settings.private_address_tooltip: Set this when participants also connect from the local network. The server then advertises both addresses, so internal clients connect directly instead of depending on NAT reflection, which many routers do not support.
settings.udp_ports_description: Audio and video travel over UDP on the range {range}. Participants cannot connect unless it is reachable from the internet. The firewall rule is created automatically on this node; forward the range on any router in front of it.
settings.stun_server_tooltip: Leave empty unless you run your own STUN server. A public one would receive the IP address of every participant.
settings.turn_ext_server_tooltip: Without a TURN server, participants behind a firewall that blocks UDP cannot join. This app ships no TURN server of its own; point this at an external one if you need it.
settings.enable_recording_tooltip: Recordings capture audio, video, chat, shared notes and presentations. Tell participants they are being recorded and obtain their consent.
settings.recording_max_age_days_invalid: Enter a whole number of days, at least 1
settings.welcome_message: Message shown in the chat when a meeting starts
settings.welcome_footer: Footer appended to the welcome message
